name: R. J. Shah & Company Limited
about: R. J. Shah & Company Limited engages in construction of small and medium size hydroelectric project with EPC contract or civil work with hydro mechanical works in India. The company is primarily involved in the underground works of tunnels, cavern shafts, inclined tunnels with government and semi governments or various electricity boards, railways, atomic power stations, irrigation, etc. and work receipts. R. J. Shah & Company Limited was incorporated in 1957 and is based in Mumbai, India.
